mask_encoding: row runs [y,x,length], absolute sheet pixel coordinates
scalpDefinition: Fixed anatomical crown underpainting for each oriented g3 head; opaque face mask sits under the hair and uses per-frame RLE. Both face options share the same crown. Baseline head locations are never reflected or rescaled.

production.method: Independent per-direction decomposition of the original g3 8-view sheet, plus manually traced spiky-hair guides and perspective bun placement. Left views use their own source cells and independent guides, never horizontal reflection. South hair2 refined in place with source hair ramp; face2 adds brown skin-shade freckles.
production.headMotion: All six south walking head components keep the same baked per-frame anchors and source motion; no runtime offsets. Standing NE/N/NW whole-cell translations are +1 px y; all others 0.

pendingAcceptance.integration: Claude assembles this full stage A in the GM creator after owner review.

leftViewEvidence.operation: Independent source-cell decomposition and per-direction path guides; no flip operations.

turn.layout: 6 rows; left 8 cells at native 1x, right same 8 cells at nearest-neighbour 2x.

previews.note: The three stage-A preview files follow the replacement preview list in spec v4.

notes: No runtime code changed. This completes stage A only; stage B includes additional walking directions and other body ages.
Hairback2 and hairback3 are intentionally transparent for the short cut and high buns; their full visible hair is in the hair layer.
The original option-1 composite is exact after documented whole-cell y alignment. Source PNGs are unchanged and no horizontal translation, scale or reflection is applied.
Back-facing eyes and mouths are empty for NE, N, NW. Face2 freckles appear only on visible cheeks.
Cape RGBA regions remain unchanged between body options. Full back views naturally conceal the shorts beneath the cape.
All preview comparisons are rendered from the delivered layer files. P3 review images are superseded by the full-A previews.

freckles.note: Separate brown pixels on pink cheeks. South and walk have 3 freckles per cheek; profile views show only the visible cheek; rear views have no facial freckles.

newPaletteShades.reason: Dark brown freckles derived from the existing tan skin ramp, separate from pink cheek shades; included in all four skin tones.
